user.title: Siemens S7 PLC
user.description: Enter your PLC connection details. Tags use PLC4X syntax ('DB1.DBD0:REAL', 'M10.5:BOOL') or nodeS7 syntax ('DB1,R0', 'M10.5', 'IW22'); separate multiple tags with newlines or semicolons. On S7-1200/1500, data blocks must have 'Optimized block access' turned off.

data_description.protocol: Legacy: classic S7 (PUT/GET) for S7-300/400 and S7-1200/1500 with PUT/GET enabled. S7CommPlus: S7-1200/1500 where PUT/GET is disabled.
data_description.rack: Used by the legacy protocol only.
data_description.slot: Used by the legacy protocol only.
